title: LinkedIn Profile Finder | Name and Company
description: LinkedIn profile finder for a person's name and company. Paste names and employers, or upload a CSV, and get the matching LinkedIn profile URL. Exact and confident matches only. Optional job title for a tighter match. Starting from $0.40 per 1,000 lookups.

people.title: People to look up
people.description: Add one or more people. Required: First name, Last name, Company. Optional: Job title (helps accuracy) and LinkedIn URL (for exact match).
people.sectionDescription: Use this form for a few contacts. For large lists, paste CSV or upload a file below.

jobTitle.title: Job title (optional)
jobTitle.description: Improves accuracy when many people share the same name.

linkedinUrl.title: LinkedIn URL (optional)
linkedinUrl.description: If you already have linkedin.com/in/... — enables exact URL matching.

peopleCsv.title: Or paste people as CSV (bulk)
peopleCsv.description:
Paste a spreadsheet export. Header row required:
firstName,lastName,company,jobTitle,linkedinUrl

jobTitle and linkedinUrl are optional columns. Example:
Nathan,Jolly,4 Pines Brewing Company Pty Ltd,Brand Manager,
Jane,Doe,Acme Inc,VP Sales,https://www.linkedin.com/in/janedoe
peopleCsv.prefill:
firstName,lastName,company,jobTitle,linkedinUrl
Nathan,Jolly,4 Pines Brewing Company Pty Ltd,Brand Manager,
Jane,Doe,Acme Inc,VP Sales,

peopleFileUrl.title: Or upload a CSV file
peopleFileUrl.description: Upload a .csv file with columns: firstName, lastName, company, and optionally jobTitle, linkedinUrl. Same format as the paste field above.

matchStrategy.title: Match strategy
matchStrategy.description:
How to decide which LinkedIn profile is the right person.

• LinkedIn URL (default) — best when the row has a LinkedIn link; exact slug match. If a row has no URL, Mawsool auto-falls back to Name + Company + Job Title.
• Name + Company + Job Title — best for most sales/recruiting lists without a LinkedIn URL.
• Name + Company — when you know the employer but not the title.
• Name + Job Title — when company name is missing or unreliable.
• Company + Job Title — find people in a role at a company (broader).
• Name / Company / Job title only — broad search; lower precision; use carefully.
matchStrategy.sectionDescription: Choose how strict matching should be. Default is LinkedIn URL (exact when URL is present).
enumTitles: LinkedIn URL — exact match (default / recommended when URL exists)
Name + Company + Job Title — recommended without LinkedIn URL
Name + Company — employer known, no title
Company + Job Title — role holders at a company

maxPeople.title: Max people per run
maxPeople.description: Safety cap for cost control. Default 100. Maximum 100,000. A large list continues if the run stops.

concurrency.title: Concurrent lookups
concurrency.description: How many people to look up at the same time. Default 10.

resumeId.title: Resume ID (optional)
resumeId.description: Reuse this ID to skip people that already succeeded in an earlier run.

freshStart.title: Look up finished people again
freshStart.description: Turn this on to ignore saved progress and look up the whole list again.
